findings.description: PFL-EMPLOYME-01 missed. The narrative for John Smith (Nova Systems Ltd.) omits weekly working hours and employment status (ground truth work_hours_per_week=null, employment_status=null). Worker only recited generic requirements and rendered no defect finding or verdict.
PFL-EMPLOYME-01 missed (scanned sibling). John Smith narrative gives salary/benefits but no weekly hours or job status; Worker produced only generic requirement recitation with no defect detection.

PFL-EMPLOYME-02 missed. Alex Taylor (Systems Analyst) duties are verbatim NOC boilerplate ('Write, modify, integrate and test software code...') and NOC/title mismatch; Worker did not flag duty/NOC mismatch or verbatim copying.
PFL-EMPLOYME-02 missed (scanned sibling). Same verbatim-NOC duty defect for Alex Taylor; Worker recited requirements only and detected nothing.

PFL-EMPLOYME-03 missed. Emily Chen (Vanguard Data Labs) narrative lacks company letterhead, address, telephone and email (ground truth company_letterhead=false, contact fields null). Worker flagged no authenticity/completeness defect.
PFL-EMPLOYME-03 missed (scanned sibling). Missing real-employer letterhead and contact info for Vanguard Data Labs; Worker produced only generic requirement claims.

PFL-EMPLOYME-04 missed. David Miller (Pinnacle Cloud) narrative is signed 'Regards, Pinnacle Cloud Solutions Team' with no supervisor name, title, or signature (ground truth all supervisor fields null). Worker detected no signatory defect.
PFL-EMPLOYME-04 missed (scanned sibling). Missing supervisor name/title/signature/contact for Pinnacle Cloud; Worker recited requirements only with no defect finding.

PFL-EMPLOYME-05 missed. Sarah Connor (Summit Enterprise Tech) narrative omits annual salary and benefits (ground truth annual_salary=null, benefits=null). Worker flagged no compensation-completeness defect.
PFL-EMPLOYME-05 missed (scanned sibling). Missing salary and benefits in Summit narrative; Worker produced only generic requirement recitation and no verdict.

Systemic across all 12 reports: Worker returned only a generic recitation of IRCC letter requirements and never assessed the attached document, extracted its fields, or issued a meets_requirements/defective verdict. No invented facts, but no document-grounded analysis. Also strengthens source 'should' to 'must' on letterhead and positions-held claims.

Citations quote the IRCC completeness-check source verbatim, but the local anchor 'pr-pdi/express-entry-applications-received-on-after-january-1-2016-completeness-check.md#019' is unverified against the local corpus (privileged research: local_corpus_verified=false).

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Require the Worker to OUTPUT a per-document verdict (meets_requirements | defective) plus a field-level checklist. For each mandatory field (company letterhead, company address/telephone/email, supervisor name+title+signature, employment start/end dates, weekly working hours, employment status, annual salary, benefits, duties) mark present/missing based on the actual document text, and list affected_fields for every missing item. Reciting generic requirements without a verdict must be treated as a failed evaluation.

Instruct the Worker that when a letter contains a boilerplate/header block plus a 'Narrative Statements / Detailed Notes' section, the narrative describing the real applicant/employer is authoritative; verify each mandatory field against the narrative and flag mismatches (e.g., header shows hours/salary but narrative omits them). Explicitly detect: missing weekly hours (PFL-01), verbatim-NOC or NOC/title mismatch duties (PFL-02), absent letterhead/contact info (PFL-03), missing supervisor signature block (PFL-04), and missing salary/benefits (PFL-05).

Add a hard gate: a document-review report is invalid if it contains zero document-specific findings and no verdict. Emit defects into claims (PII-free, with affected_fields) and keep applicant identifiers only in basis[]. Add a rule to flag job duties copied verbatim from NOC lead-statement/main-duties text.

rationale: All 12 Worker reports are near-identical generic recitations of IRCC employment-letter requirements; the Worker never extracted document fields, never issued a meets_requirements/defective verdict, and detected none of the 5 injected defect families. Defect_recall is therefore 0.0 for all 10 defective cases and 1.0 for the 2 clean cases (nothing to miss). Grounding is otherwise reasonable (0.88–0.92): claims are supported by the cited IRCC completeness-check source with no fabricated facts, docked slightly for strengthening 'should'→'must'. Citation_exactness (0.9) reflects verbatim-correct quotes to the correct authoritative document, minus an unverified local anchor (#019). PII containment is clean (1.0): claims/prose are generic and basis[] uses placeholders, no applicant PII leaked. Blind_input_compliance is 1.0: the uniformly generic output shows no ground-truth leakage. The dominant, critical failure is total absence of defect detection.
